test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Her **__progress__** is unparalleled with that of any other teacher.
solution: The correct answer is **"betterment."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Progress" **means movement forwards or towards achieving something. (आगे की ओर या लक्ष्‍य की ओर गति; प्रगति) • **Example**: *Amit’s making **progress**__ at school.* • **"Betterment"** means improvement or progress, which fits the context of the sentence. (सुधार या प्रगति) __ • **Example**: *They believed that what they were doing was vital for the **betterment**__ of society.* • The sentence is comparing the progress of the teacher to that of other teachers, and **"betterment"** is the most appropriate option to describe her progress. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Plight:** a difficult or dangerous situation. (दुर्दशा; प्रतिकूल या कठिन दशा या स्थिति) • **Scenario:** a possible situation or sequence of events. (भावी घटनाओं का परिदृश्‍य) • **Dilemma:** a difficult choice between two options. (दो या अधिक वस्तुओं में से एक का चयन करने की कठिन स्थिति, दुविधा, असमंजस) 3b:Tdf0, The correct answer is **"obligation."**
